proposals.name: backup_to_onedrive
proposals.reason: backup is policy+verification+evidence in cosmos_backup with the OneDrive destination probed as a cosmos_surfaces surface (hash compare, off-machine, scope by irreplaceability)

proposals.name: backup_watchdog
proposals.reason: a watchdog that never executed is not a backup; cosmos_backup carries the scheduled verification, cosmos_surfaces the reachability probe

proposals.name: bootup
proposals.reason: BootUP is start_session: read the prior SEED under its declared length/hash, inject facts and watchers, open a new cosmos_context.Session, return inherited context

proposals.name: bts_bus
proposals.reason: message bus role is IPC (cosmos_mail) + scheduling (cosmos_sched) + liveness (cosmos_health); no standalone bus survives

proposals.name: bts_cop
proposals.reason: cost projection folds into cosmos_spend; thinking billed at output rate is priced there, not re-derived per rail

proposals.name: bts_cursor
proposals.reason: cosmos_rails ApiRail adapter (Cursor link driver), dispatchable from a queue lane; key stays in .secrets, never the repo

proposals.name: bts_drive_health
proposals.reason: the SMART probe attaches as a cosmos_surfaces surface probe: report reachability + uncorrected reads, evacuate not monitor for an opaque USB-bridged single copy

proposals.name: bts_dymon
proposals.reason: the dynamic monitor becomes health checks on a schedule with mail notification - cosmos_health + cosmos_sched + cosmos_mail

proposals.name: bts_elevated_ops
proposals.reason: COSMOS uses the same elevated queue; the privileged worker survives as an EXTERNAL helper the OS dispatches to (one UAC click), not a module it absorbs - the credential boundary stays outside Core

proposals.name: bts_gem
proposals.reason: cosmos_rails ApiRail adapter for the Vertex/GEM link; keep-separate from the Studio wrapper, Never Activate boundary preserved

proposals.name: bts_gw
proposals.reason: cosmos_rails ApiRail adapter sharing the SGH ceiling; unpriced != $0 is enforced by the spend gate, not the driver

proposals.name: bts_health
proposals.reason: cosmos_health on kernel selftests with positive AND negative controls - a health row that could never go red is the scar it closes

proposals.name: bts_identity
proposals.reason: MESH_ID + PEERS move to cosmos_identity; federation blockers tracked as a function return, not a remembered count

proposals.name: bts_kdash_feed
proposals.reason: KDash becomes an API projection client of cosmos_service /api/v1; no file-reading dashboard, so writer-splits-from-launcher cannot recur

proposals.name: bts_node
proposals.reason: node loop decomposes into the same three OS primitives

proposals.name: bts_oa_api
proposals.reason: cosmos_rails ApiRail adapter (OpenAI link); the two-ledger / two-ceiling split rides on cosmos_spend, breaker in the caller

proposals.name: bts_paths
proposals.reason: spike successor cosmos_paths: resolve-or-raise, one configured root, explicit boot instantiation, import-time side effects dropped

proposals.name: bts_phone
proposals.reason: spike successor cosmos_mail: probe-not-assume kept, dead != no-news, adds send + per-worker identity + staleness policy

proposals.name: bts_policy
proposals.reason: the speed<->cost knob and DOM-vs-API routing live with the ledger in cosmos_spend that enforces them

proposals.name: bts_poller
proposals.reason: polling becomes scheduled probes (cosmos_sched) reporting to cosmos_health and mailing via cosmos_mail

proposals.name: bts_runner
proposals.reason: queue tick splits: cosmos_sched owns concurrency/priority/registry, cosmos_runner keeps claim-by-rename, worded outcomes, log-first, report-never-retry, append-only ledger

proposals.name: bts_serve
proposals.reason: static file serving folds into cosmos_service, the single API surface

proposals.name: bts_sgh
proposals.reason: becomes a cosmos_rails ApiRail adapter (SuperGrok link driver): metered rail, not the floor; DOM-first, spend-gated

proposals.name: bts_spend
proposals.reason: spend ledger centralizes in cosmos_spend: append-only, per-rail ceilings, breaker-in-the-caller

proposals.name: bts_watchdog
proposals.reason: watchdog is a scheduled health probe that mails on failure - the same three primitives, no bespoke daemon

proposals.name: corrections
proposals.reason: carry-over corrections flow through cosmos_context + ledger (count-weighted, printed at boot); keep the doc renderer, validate on close

proposals.name: mesh_fanout
proposals.reason: vendor-plural fan-out becomes cosmos_crucible; single-family agreement proves nothing, so the crucible requires disagreeing families by design

proposals.name: rail_check
proposals.reason: rails matrix becomes measured registry probes: cosmos_registry holds the entries, cosmos_rails probes them - no new .bat

proposals.name: scars
proposals.reason: scars-as-query moves to cosmos_context + ledger, the evidence primitive; keep the doc renderer, replace the silent --selftest no-op

proposals.name: task_registry
proposals.reason: scheduled-task registry role absorbed by cosmos_sched: zero red, machine count == registry count, no drive literals or relative paths

proposals.name: tidyup
proposals.reason: TidyUP/T2 is close_session: validate every control file parses AND validates, write a next-session SEED of inherited facts + open watchers + handoff via cosmos_context.Session/boot_inherit

proposals.name: tools_sync
proposals.reason: the tools index flows through cosmos_context + ledger; keep the check-then-write doc renderer, OWNER names the live index path first

proposals.name: tree_lock
proposals.reason: spike successor cosmos_lock: advisory cooperative lock cannot be ported - leases + fencing tokens + fenced commit replace it

proposals.name: verify_conf
proposals.reason: every control file must parse AND validate - cosmos_validate enforces both, refusing to close on a file that only parses

proposals.name: verify_pointers
proposals.reason: pointer integrity becomes a cosmos_validate gate; a point-in-time green run is replaced by content-hash notarization (TOCTOU closed)
